tools.name: search_creators
tools.description: Find CollabPls creators by city, name/handle, STD-tested window, or verification. Returns SFW public profiles + profile URLs. Prefer reachable creators for outreach.

tools.name: list_schedule
tools.description: List open availability windows (who is filming where/when) on the CollabPls schedule board. Best tool when a creator wants a scene partner in a city this week.

tools.name: find_overlaps
tools.description: Find pairs of creators with overlapping availability windows in the same city (case-normalized city_text + date overlap). Use when someone asks for scene partners already on the board in a city this week.

tools.name: inventory_snapshot
tools.description: Counts of open schedule windows by city, open listings total, and reachable-creators estimate. Use for market overview / inventory questions.

tools.name: get_profile
tools.description: Fetch one public CollabPls creator profile by slug or X handle.

tools.name: list_open_calls
tools.description: List open collab call listings (photo/video/livestream asks) on CollabPls.

tools.name: get_collab_context
tools.description: How CollabPls works, key links, and how agents should help humans find scene partners. Call first if unfamiliar.
